thread:
Nina (People Ops): Heads up team — finalizing a small but important handbook update to the Leaves & Time section. We're splitting "bereavement" and "compassionate" into distinct subsections, adding 3 short examples, and adding an accommodations request link. Rolling out manager-required microtraining (15m) + 5-question open-book quiz. Acks required from the whole company by EOM. Links below.
Omar (People Ops): timeline and scope?
Nina (People Ops): Announcement going out today. Managers: mandatory microtraining + quiz, completion window = 10 business days. All staff: read diff + ack by end of month. Live Q&A drop-ins planned (EMEA / APAC). RSVP link: https://tiny.redwood/leave-update-rsvp
Jordan (Eng Manager): For managers outside US — will the policy examples include country-specific notes? Our EU teams need clarity on statutory bereavement vs company compassionate.
Priya (HRBP): Good catch. The handbook will include a short "Regional notes" callout pointing to the local country annexes. I'll coordinate a quick review with regional HR leads. Also building a manager-friendly CSV for tracking.
Sofia (Legal): I reviewed the language. This is clarifying guidance, not a contractual change. If any employment agreement references "bereavement" specifically, flag to me and we'll advise on case-by-case basis before sending individual ack requests.
Jordan (Eng Manager): Can we get a manager roster export and an automated nudging cadence? Our org uses the weekly digest to catch stragglers.
notify-bot: Training created: "Leaves: Bereavement vs Compassionate (2026-Q3)". Training ID: lr-2026-07-01. Quiz ID: qz-lr-2026-07-01. Results webhook: https://api.redwood.local/webhooks/training-results/lr-2026-07-01
Omar (People Ops): CSV columns I'm planning: manager_email,org_unit,team_headcount,managers_quiz_status,quiz_score,training_viewed,ack_status,ack_timestamp,accommodation_flag
Priya (HRBP): I'll add a "note" column for escalations / accommodation requests and a separate column for region.
Nina (People Ops): Pass threshold = 75%. Managers who don't complete will receive automated reminders at day 5 and day 8; non-compliance after day 10 -> HRBP outreach. If someone fails the quiz twice, schedule a short coach call with their HRBP.
Jordan (Eng Manager): Can the results feed into our LMS? An SFTP drop for CSV would be ideal.
notify-bot: Weekly CSV export scheduled (Friday 05:00 UTC) to sftp://payroll-exports.redwood/peopleops/leave-update/
Sofia (Legal): One more: add a short sentence in the ack about where to direct questions and who to contact for privacy/medical info. Keeps us covered.
Omar (People Ops): Action items:
- Nina: publish announcement and post pinned links (owner)
- Priya: regional callout + HR lead review (owner)
- Omar: automation for CSV + SFTP export (owner)
- Sofia: final legal check on ack copy (owner)
Deadlines: publish today; manager completion window opens immediately for 10 business days.
Jordan (Eng Manager): I'll forward roster to Omar and nudge team leads. Thanks.
Nina (People Ops): Thanks everyone. I'll post the finalized manager email template and calendar invites in ~1 hour. Ping me or @Sofia if you see any edge-case contracts. :white_check_mark:
